g.text: Synthetic radar: 384 km x 384 km, 2 km pixels, 5-min frames; power-law log-rain field whose small scales decorrelate faster, moving
uniformly at 39 km/h. Motion from block matching of three frame pairs; learned blend = ridge regression of log rain on the extrapolated
field smoothed at 4 scales, trained on earlier frames. 15 test times.
